windows2000.note: A diagnostic NIC rebind was opened after the failure, then its signature dialog was declined. No repaired result is claimed.

harness_events: The first W2K failure readback requested USBLOG.TXT in WINNT, where it does not exist. Its incomplete directory is retained; a separate complete SYS/NATIVE.LOG readback succeeds.
The initial legacy closure script expected PASS for TCP host reports, whose documented result is PASS_HOST_PAYLOAD. The corrected closure also checks per-direction totals and closed capture hashes.
